description: Regression suite built from a live manual QA session against a real JNJ 10-K (jnj-10k-2026-02-11) and the physics textbook, in a mixed multi-document corpus. Covers two bug classes fixed the same day: (1) conversation-continuity corruption -- a follow-up with no distinguishing vocabulary silently resolving to an unrelated document and then poisoning the thread's saved hint for every subsequent generic question, and (2) imprecise prefix matching -- 'Item 7' matching 'Item 7A', 'Chapter 1' matching 'Chapter 10'-'19', etc. Cases in the same thread_group execute in file order sharing one thread_id, reproducing the exact multi-turn sequence that originally broke.
prerequisites: Corpus must contain MULTIPLE documents (continuity/collision bugs only reproduce with more than one document) -- verified against a real corpus of 10+ filings plus the textbook.

cases.question: What were Johnson & Johnson net earnings for 2025, and how did that compare to 2024?
cases.notes: Establishes the thread's document context for every case below.

cases.question: What was diluted EPS for 2025?
cases.notes: Regression: 'EPS' was picked up as a doc-name anchor and substring-matched 'steps'/'sweeps' throughout the physics textbook via raw CONTAINS, resolving here instead of JNJ. Fixed via word-boundary matching in document_resolver.py.

cases.question: What was total revenue/net sales for 2025?
cases.notes: Regression: cascaded from jnj_c02's wrong hint being saved as the new thread document.

cases.question: What was total stockholders' equity?
What was the effective tax rate for 2025?
What were sales for the MedTech segment in 2025?
cases.notes: Always resolved correctly even before the fix -- 'MedTech' is distinctive enough to win strict resolution on its own. Kept as a control case.

cases.question: What were Innovative Medicine segment sales?
cases.notes: Control case -- resolving correctly also resets the thread's hint back to JNJ for the next cases.

cases.question: How did the two segments compare in operating margin?
cases.notes: KNOWN CONTENT GAP, not a bug: verified live the filing reports segment sales and segment income before tax, but never states an explicit 'operating margin' percentage -- the raw components exist to compute one, but nothing currently synthesizes derived metrics across chunks. Only asserting the thread stayed on the right document; not asserting a numeric answer.

cases.question: Ask net earnings first, then without naming the company:
What was diluted EPS?
cases.notes: Second occurrence of the exact original regression trigger, without 'for 2025' this time -- must not re-corrupt the thread for the remaining cases.

cases.question: What was the effective tax rate?
What does Item 1A say about the main risk factors?
What does Item 7 discuss regarding results of operations?
cases.notes: Original symptom: an EMPTY assistant response. Also guards the separate prefix-boundary fix directly -- JNJ has both 'Item 7' and 'Item 7A' sections; STARTS WITH with no boundary check non-deterministically returned 7A's market-risk content instead.

cases.question: What does Item 9A say about controls and procedures?
What does the document say about litigation or legal proceedings?
What are Johnson & Johnson's main business segments?
What does Johnson & Johnson's 10-K filing say about R&D spending?
Who are the executive officers listed?
cases.notes: KNOWN UNFIXED BUG, expected to currently FAIL with this exact (generic, no-company-named) wording -- a more specific phrasing like 'Johnson & Johnson's executive officers?' happens to retrieve correctly, but this is the wording actually reported. Verified live: the filing lists 10 named officers (Duato, Schmid, Taubert, Wolk, ...) as separate Section nodes on pages 47-50, but they got nested under an unrelated 'Item 1B' Chapter due to a heading-detection heuristic misplacement -- this filing has no embedded PDF outline/TOC, so the TOC-based structure fix doesn't apply to it. Document resolution itself is correct (lands on JNJ); the retrieval-within-document step is what misses the names for generic phrasing. Needs either a heuristic-detection improvement (explicitly deferred -- whack-a-mole risk) or a retrieval-side fix (broader graph traversal from the intro section, independent of query wording). Kept in the suite as a live regression target, not silently dropped.

cases.question: List every Check Your Understanding question in Chapter 15 of the physics textbook.
cases.notes: Guards the Chapter-N structural reference + context-budget fixes -- this exact question hung, then crashed with a rate-limit error, then returned irrelevant pages across three iterations of that fix.

cases.question: How does the treatment of momentum in Chapter 9 relate to angular momentum in Chapter 11 of the physics textbook?
cases.notes: Guards the multi-reference fix -- previously silently narrowed to Chapter 9 alone and reported Chapter 11 'not covered'.

cases.question: Tell me about Example 2.8 Direction of Motion from the physics textbook.
cases.notes: KNOWN UNFIXED REGRESSION, expected to currently FAIL: worked examples aren't in the PDF's own embedded outline, so the TOC-based chapter-structure fix no longer indexes them as their own Section nodes. Was working before that fix (commit c4116b9); flagged as a deliberate trade-off, not silently dropped. Planned remediation: a visual/heading-classification pass within each TOC-derived section (see project_next_session_goals memory).

What was Amazon's net sales for the quarter ended June 30, 2016?
What was Amazon's operating income for this quarter?
cases.notes: Follow-up with no quarter/year restated -- continuity within the amzn_10q thread_group.

How much cash and cash equivalents did Amazon have as of June 30, 2016?

cases.notes: Pre-confirmed value, independent of this session's fixes.

cases.question: What does Item 1A report about risk factors?
What does Item 1C say about cybersecurity?
cases.notes: Newer, less common Item letter suffix -- distinct SEC item code from the Item 9A/9C family already covered elsewhere.

cases.question: What does Item 9A report about the effectiveness of Tesla's internal controls?
What does Item 9C disclose about foreign jurisdictions that prevent inspections?
cases.notes: Rare item code, good edge case for the Item-N-with-letter-suffix structural pattern -- correctly returns 'Not applicable' rather than a wrong/empty answer, since Tesla's own filing states that verbatim.

cases.question: What is the table of contents?
cases.notes: Bare 'table of contents' with no document named -- relies on thread continuity within tsla_10k.

cases.question: Give me an overview of this 10-K.
What does Item 3 say about legal proceedings?
cases.notes: Bare 'Item 3' (no letter suffix) -- distinguishes correctly from Tesla's own Item 3-adjacent items.

cases.question: What were Goldman Sachs's net earnings for 2025, and how did that compare to 2024?
What was diluted EPS and ROE for 2025?
cases.notes: Same class of query as the JNJ 'diluted EPS' continuity bug -- confirms the word-boundary document-resolution fix generalizes to another filing/thread.

cases.question: What was book value per common share?
What does Item 1C say about cybersecurity?
What does Item 7A report about quantitative and qualitative disclosures about market risk?
What does Item 9 discuss regarding accountants and financial disclosure?
cases.notes: Plain 'Item 9' (no letter suffix) -- must resolve distinctly from 'Item 9A'/'Item 9C' in the same filing (Goldman's own 10-K has all three).

cases.question: What does Item 12 say about security ownership of beneficial owners?
What does Note 13 discuss?
cases.notes: KNOWN UNFIXED BUG, expected to currently FAIL: verified live the Section node titled 'Note 13.' has literally 8 characters of text (just its own title, no body) -- the real footnote content is deep in 'Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements', but 'Note 13.' ALSO appears as a bare entry on this filing's own notes INDEX/TOC page, and heading detection promoted that empty index-page occurrence to its own Section instead of the real one. Distinct, narrower bug from the two already-known gaps -- ingestion doesn't yet disambiguate an index/list occurrence of a heading-shaped string from the real section start when both exist in the same document. Not yet root-caused into a general fix; flagged here as a live regression target.

cases.question: What role does GS Bank USA (GSBE) play in the firm's operations?
What did it say about risk management?
cases.notes: Bare pronoun follow-up, no document named -- must not drift to JPM/AAPL/any other filing in the corpus. Direct continuity guard, same bug class as the JNJ cases.
